description: We are a team of four enthusiastic students interested in technology, space exploration and web development. We enjoy working together, sharing ideas and building creative solutions. Our skills include React, JavaScript, Node.js, Express and MySQL. We are excited to explore NASA's challenges, learn new things and develop innovative web-based projects.
summary:
Space Legacy is an interactive educational web platform that explores the history and legacy of space exploration equipment. It showcases important spacecraft, landers, and rovers from historic space missions, explaining their original purposes, technologies, scientific contributions, and what happened to them after their missions.

Through images, informative descriptions, and an easy-to-navigate interface, the platform helps users understand how early space exploration missions contributed to modern space science and technology.

By bringing these historical missions together in one place, Space Legacy makes space exploration more accessible, engaging, and educational.
details:
About the Project

Space Legacy aims to preserve and present the history of important space exploration equipment through an interactive digital platform.

Many spacecraft and robotic explorers played significant roles in advancing our understanding of the Moon and Mars. However, the stories behind these machines, their technological contributions, and their final locations are not always widely known.

Our platform brings these stories together in an organized and visually engaging format.

Key Features

  • Interactive Equipment Dictionary: Explore important space exploration equipment through images and descriptions.
  • Mission Information: Learn about the missions, their objectives, and their historical significance.
  • Technology and Instruments: Understand the technologies and scientific instruments used.
  • Scientific Contributions: Discover how each mission helped advance space research.
  • Mission Legacy: Explore what happened to the equipment after its mission ended.
  • Visual Learning: Use images and structured information to make learning about space exploration easier.

Featured Missions

  1. Apollo Lunar Module Descent Stages (1969)
  2. Apollo Lunar Roving Vehicle (1971)
  3. Surveyor 3 (1967)
  4. Sojourner Mars Rover (1997)

Our Goal

Our goal is to create an accessible digital collection that connects the achievements of early space exploration with the future of scientific discovery.
